Help center

Where are my packs saved?

Only on this device and browser. Using another device or clearing your browser data can erase them.

Can the AI make mistakes?

Yes. Always check the results against your course material.

Why can’t my photo or PDF be read?

Use a clear, well-lit photo. PDFs work best under 15 pages and 15 MB. Hard-to-read handwriting may come out as [unclear].

I forgot my password.

Passwords can’t be recovered because your profile is stored only on this device. You can sign up again to replace it.

User guide

  1. Sign up, or continue as a guest.
  2. Open Create, type your notes and say what you want.
  3. Add photos or a PDF if you have them (optional).
  4. Press Create pack, then review it in Study and History.

Confidentiality

  • Your name, age, school level, email and profile picture are saved only on this device.
  • Your password is stored only as a scrambled hash on this device and is never sent anywhere.
  • The notes, photos and PDF pages you add are sent to an AI service to create your pack. Don’t add anything private.
  • AI can make mistakes. Use material you are allowed to use, for personal study only.
Go back

You can create your pack right away, or press “Read text from photos” first to check the text. You can also drag files in or paste an image. Photos, PDFs and text files work; Word files are not supported yet. PDFs up to 15 pages and 15 MB work best.
